title: VIP Chapter 1 Week 2: Shape of Ethiopia & Map Reading

questions.text: Ethiopia's compact shape gives it which ADVANTAGE?
questions.explanation: Compact shape = shorter borders to defend, easier internal communication.

questions.text: A country with MANY ISLANDS has which shape?
questions.explanation: Fragmented = many separate pieces/islands (Philippines, Indonesia).

questions.text: Which country has an ELONGATED shape?
questions.explanation: Chile is long and narrow (4,300 km long, 350 km wide).

questions.text: South Africa surrounds Lesotho. South Africa is:
questions.explanation: Perforated = completely surrounds another country.

questions.text: Thailand's peninsula extension makes it:
questions.explanation: Protruded = large extension from main body.

questions.text: Compactness formula is:
questions.explanation: Higher ratio = more compact.

questions.text: Ethiopia's compactness ratio is approximately:
questions.explanation: 1,100,000/5,328 ≈ 206.5 km² per km boundary.

questions.text: A map showing POPULATION DENSITY is which type?
questions.explanation: Statistical maps show numerical data distributions.

questions.text: The LEGEND on a map:
questions.explanation: Legend/Key decodes the map's symbols.

questions.text: Contour lines on a topographical map show:
questions.explanation: Contour lines connect equal elevation points.

questions.text: Which is NOT a marginal information element?
questions.explanation: River color is IN the map body. Title, scale, legend are marginal.

questions.text: A country with a PROTRUDED shape faces which challenge?
options: A) Easy to govern all regions equally
B) Harder to govern distant protruding regions
questions.correct_answer: B) Harder to govern distant protruding regions
questions.explanation: Protrusions are far from the center, making administration harder.

questions.text: The NORTH ARROW on a map shows:
questions.explanation: North Arrow indicates which way is north.

questions.text: FRAGMENTED countries have which ADVANTAGE?
questions.explanation: Many islands = more coastlines = more marine resources.

questions.text: Ethiopia's borders measure approximately:
questions.explanation: Ethiopia has ~5,328 km of borders.

questions.text: A TOPICAL map shows:
questions.explanation: Topical/Special purpose maps focus on one theme.

questions.text: PERFORATED countries are RARE because:
options: B) They create complex political situations
questions.correct_answer: B) They create complex political situations
questions.explanation: Surrounding another country creates political/economic dependencies.

questions.text: Map SCALE tells you:
options: B) The relationship between map distance and ground distance
D) When the map was made
questions.correct_answer: B) The relationship between map distance and ground distance
questions.explanation: Scale = map distance : ground distance ratio.

questions.text: Ethiopia's compact shape makes INTERNAL CONFLICT:
questions.explanation: Compact shape = easier communication = stronger national unity.

questions.text: Which is the FIRST step in reading a map?
questions.explanation: Always start with the TITLE to understand what the map shows.
